limitations: New producer layout and first two history membership contracts: reverse logical visit order; optional independent cutoff stops at first key<=bound; second history also skips row+30 zero after cutoff.

Rust closes flat-ring membership only, returns physical indices and performs no opaque projection. Valid initialized ring length<=capacity and nonempty head in one-wrap domain are premises; invalid source input returns explicit errors rather than inventing native behavior.

Tree iteration, inner set/projector payload semantics, account-filtered collection, final64B helper payload, state-field protocol names, concurrency/coherence and full176B semantic result remain open.
